# FaithWall

> FaithWall is an iPhone app, free to download, that puts the Bible verses you choose on your lock screen. Using it requires a FaithWall subscription. You pick your own verses (book/chapter/verse or search, 24 translations) and show them as a lock-screen wallpaper or a lock-screen widget. It is not a Bible reader.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: iOS app for daily Bible verses on the iPhone lock screen
- **Platform**: iOS 16.0 and later
- **Price**: Free to download; a subscription is required to use the app. Price, billing period and any trial offer are shown in the App Store before paying.
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lock-screen-bible-verse/id6756815070
- **Website**: https://faithwall.app
- **Author / Founder**: Karol Billik
- **Built by**: karchi. (https://www.karchi.xyz/)
- **Contact**: hello@faithwall.app
- **Minimum iOS**: 16.0

## Pricing

FaithWall is free to download, but using it requires a subscription (there is no free tier). The price, billing period and any trial offer are shown in the App Store before you pay, in your local currency.

Payments are handled by Apple through the App Store.

## How it works

You choose your own verses by book, chapter and verse or by search, in 24 translations. After subscribing you pick how to show them:
1. **Wallpaper**: a full-screen lock-screen wallpaper applied with an Apple Shortcut.
2. **Widget**: a compact lock-screen widget that rotates your saved verses every hour, 8 hours or day.

The app interface is available in 10 languages. FaithWall is not a Bible reader.

## What makes it different

- **Single-purpose**: Most Christian apps try to do everything. FaithWall does one thing — your chosen Scripture on the lock screen.
- **Your verses**: You pick the verses; the app does not pick them for you.
